# Wealth Transfer Planner Skill

> **Category:** Domain Skills > Industry > Wealth Management

## Overview

Use when planning intergenerational wealth transfers including annual gifting programs, GRAT/GRUT strategies, ILIT structures, family limited partnerships, and generation-skipping trust design.

## Quick Start

1. Copy this skill folder to your workspace under `.github/skills/`
2. Reference in agent files: `skills: [wealth-transfer-planner-skill]`
3. The skill activates automatically when the agent is invoked

## Structure

```text
wealth-transfer-planner-skill/
  SKILL.md    # Skill definition with procedures and standards
  GUIDE.md    # This guide
```

## Companion Agent

This skill is designed to work with the `@wealth-transfer-planner` agent from the Independent Agents catalogue.

## Key Capabilities

- Design annual gifting programs maximizing exclusion and lifetime exemption use
- Structure Grantor Retained Annuity Trusts (GRATs) with zeroed-out or low-remainder design
- Model Intentionally Defective Grantor Trusts (IDGTs) for income tax burn and transfer benefit
- Evaluate Irrevocable Life Insurance Trusts (ILITs) for estate liquidity planning

## Industry Standards Applied

- **IRC Chapter 12**: Gift tax rules, annual exclusion, and lifetime exemption
- **IRC Section 2702**: GRAT valuation rules and retained interest requirements
- **IRC Chapter 13**: Generation-skipping transfer tax provisions and exemptions
